item.title: Recordati Takeover Bid
item.description:
• Summary: A consortium led by CVC Capital Partners has tabled a €12.4 billion takeover bid to take Italian drugmaker Recordati private. The offer includes a tender for all outstanding shares and a delisting plan. The deal would give the private equity firm control of Recordati's stable of rare-disease drugs and established commercial infrastructure. Separately, a related article notes that SOBI's gout drug passed a Phase 3 test, though this is tangential to the core theme.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Pharmaceutical Technology, BioSpace

item.title: AbbVie Layoffs (Allergan Aesthetics)
item.description:
• Summary: AbbVie has announced plans to lay off 85 employees tied to its Allergan Aesthetics division in California, as part of a broader workforce reduction. The cuts come as the company consolidates operations following the Allergan acquisition. A second article notes Novartis also disclosed 76 layoffs in New Jersey, but the core theme focuses on AbbVie's restructuring within its aesthetics unit.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, Fierce Pharma

item.title: Gilead Tubulis Acquisition
item.description:
• Summary: Gilead Sciences has acquired Tubulis, a German biotechnology company specializing in antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). Tubulis' proprietary platform enables the generation of ADCs with improved stability and efficacy. The acquisition bolsters Gilead's oncology pipeline, adding novel conjugation technologies that could be applied to develop next-generation ADCs. Financial terms were not disclosed.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
